topic: Recipe Module Behavior and Cold-Start Gate
evidence: Recipe is the entry gate. Steps: 1) check for existing recipe.json (load if session_id matches, stop); 2) run detection scan (priority: existing recipe > design docs > platform configs > dir structure > user intent > ask); 2b) module specificity scoring (file_path_patterns match beats generic ALL activators); 2c) assess input quality (vague=named artifact/measurable outcome/constraint/scope boundary all absent; broad=two interpretations >=0.5 each with no disambiguating signal; routing: vague+!broad->Enhance->ScopeFrame; broad+!vague->Sharpen->ScopeFrame; vague+broad->both; neither->ScopeFrame direct); 2d) cold-start verification (AUGMENT) — check rules/cold-start.md for each selected module; missing->MISSING_COLD_START, surface all missing paths, do not write recipe.json; 3) score complexity (Low/Medium/High); 4) write recipe.json with cold_start_verified: true; 5) write receipt.
